name: How long does a typical kitchen pathway widening project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen pathway widening project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for widening a kitchen pathway depends on the project's scope. A minor alteration, such as moving an island or reconfiguring cabinets without structural changes, might take 1-3 weeks. If the project involves removing load-bearing walls, relocating plumbing or electrical systems, or extensive redesign, it could extend to 4-8 weeks or even longer. Permitting and inspection processes also influence the overall duration. We provide a detailed timeline after the initial consultation and design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor changes take 1-3 weeks; structural work with utility relocation can take 4-8 weeks or more. Permitting also affects the timeline.
